text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 56-58 पर बातचीत पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 56-58 par baatcheet padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the dialogue on pages 56–58 of your book, then answer.

steps.question: What is a disaster?
options: an unexpected event like a flood or fire that causes great damage
steps.answer: an unexpected event like a flood or fire that causes great damage
steps.modelAnswer: A disaster is an unexpected event, such as an accident, a flood or a fire. It kills or injures a lot of people or causes a lot of damage to property.

modelMeaning.hi: आपदा एक अचानक होने वाली घटना है, जैसे दुर्घटना, बाढ़ या आग। इसमें बहुत लोग मरते या घायल होते हैं, या संपत्ति का बहुत नुक़सान होता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Aapda ek achaanak hone waali ghatna hai, jaise durghatna, baadh ya aag. Ismein bahut log marte ya ghaayal hote hain, ya sampatti ka bahut nuksaan hota hai.

steps.question: What are epidemics?
options: infectious diseases that spread over a large population
steps.answer: infectious diseases that spread over a large population
steps.modelAnswer: Epidemics are infectious diseases which spread over a large population through contaminated water, food and air.

modelMeaning.hi: महामारी ऐसी संक्रामक बीमारियाँ हैं जो गंदे पानी, खाने और हवा से बहुत लोगों में फैलती हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mahaamaari aisi sankraamak beemaariyaan hain jo gande paani, khaane aur hawa se bahut logon mein phailti hain.

steps.question: What are the ill effects of floods?

questionMeaning.hi: बाढ़ के बुरे असर क्या हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Baadh ke bure asar kya hain?

options: loss of life and property, epidemics and soil erosion
steps.answer: loss of life and property, epidemics and soil erosion
steps.modelAnswer: The ill effects of floods are destruction of life and property, epidemics like cholera and malaria, and soil erosion.

modelMeaning.hi: बाढ़ से जान-माल का नुक़सान, हैज़ा-मलेरिया जैसी महामारियाँ और मिट्टी का कटाव होता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Baadh se jaan-maal ka nuksaan, haiza-malaria jaisi mahaamaariyaan aur mitti ka kataav hota hai.

steps.question: How are human beings responsible for causing floods?

questionMeaning.hi: बाढ़ के लिए इंसान कैसे ज़िम्मेदार हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Baadh ke liye insaan kaise zimmedaar hain?

options: by deforestation, faulty dams and breaches in embankments
steps.answer: by deforestation, faulty dams and breaches in embankments
steps.modelAnswer: Human beings cause floods by deforestation, faulty dam construction and breaches in embankments, for example by railway routes near river banks.

modelMeaning.hi: इंसान जंगल काटकर, गलत बाँध बनाकर और तटबंधों में दरार डालकर (जैसे नदी किनारे रेल लाइन) बाढ़ का कारण बनते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Insaan jungle kaatkar, galat baandh banaakar aur tatbandhon mein daraar daalkar (jaise nadi kinaare rail line) baadh ka kaaran bante hain.

steps.question: How is our life affected by floods?

questionMeaning.hi: बाढ़ से हमारी ज़िंदगी पर क्या असर होता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Baadh se hamaari zindagi par kya asar hota hai?

options: We lose homes, cattle and health, and diseases spread.
We get a long holiday only.
steps.answer: We lose homes, cattle and health, and diseases spread.
steps.modelAnswer: Floods destroy our homes, crops and cattle. Diseases like cholera, malaria and diarrhoea spread, and the soil is washed away.

modelMeaning.hi: बाढ़ से घर, फ़सलें और पशु बर्बाद होते हैं। हैज़ा, मलेरिया, दस्त जैसी बीमारियाँ फैलती हैं और मिट्टी बह जाती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Baadh se ghar, fasalein aur pashu barbaad hote hain. Haiza, malaria, dast jaisi beemaariyaan phailti hain aur mitti beh jaati hai.

text.hi: (B) बाढ़ में बचाव के तरीक़े: सही को ‘करो’ में, गलत को ‘मत करो’ में रखो।
text.hinglish: (B) Baadh mein bachaav ke tareeqe: sahi ko ‘karo’ mein, galat ko ‘mat karo’ mein rakho.
text.en: (B) Safety measures during a flood: put each one in Do or Don't.

instruction.hi: बाढ़ में क्या करें, क्या न करें?
instruction.hinglish: Baadh mein kya karein, kya na karein?
instruction.en: In a flood: do or don't?

steps.question: (C) What are the ways to purify drinking water?

questionMeaning.hi: पीने का पानी कैसे साफ़ करें?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Peene ka paani kaise saaf karein?

options: Use chlorine tablets or boil it.
Keep it in the sun for a minute.
steps.answer: Use chlorine tablets or boil it.
steps.modelAnswer: We can purify drinking water by using chlorine tablets or by boiling it.

modelMeaning.hi: पीने का पानी क्लोरीन की गोली डालकर या उबालकर साफ़ कर सकते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Peene ka paani chlorine ki goli daalkar ya ubaalkar saaf kar sakte hain.
